verdict.rationale: Martin's documentation covers only conversational interfaces (phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, Slack) and integrations. It shows no documented public API, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. The llms.txt docs index and the email/Slack channels are adjacent ways to reach the assistant, not a programmatic API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
